label: A_mC4_12_i-001
title: $\alpha$-O$_{2}$ Structure
comments: Solid oxygen can be found in the \href{current_web_home_dir/A_mC4_12_i-001}{$\alpha$-O$_{2}$ phase} below 24K and in the \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hR2_166_c-003}{$\beta$-O$_{2}$} phase between 24 and 44K, with $\gamma$-O$_{2}$, stable between 44 and 54K, in the \href{current_web_home_dir/A_cP8_223_ac-001}{$\beta$-F$_{2}$ structure} (Meier, 1984).
